answer: The protocol requires 1,000 hashes per cycle. Agents vine into a chronological linkage of headers; without this vine, state updates fail. Each agent must pulse a proof-of-work; a lack of pulse triggers a penalty. An honest cost of 1 hash is required, while 1,000 identities cost 1,000 hashes. A quill checks the finalized log; no quill means invalid history. The verifier validates the vine and pulse then uses a quill to sign.
